newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London up as Dow firms.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London up as Dow firms.

text.p: Hong Kong shares firmed slightly on Friday, following Wall Street's strong lead and amid continuing interest in bank shares.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 33.92 points to 14,689.05 by1420 GMT.
"We are moving with the FTSE (100 Index) and picked up now with the Dow", a trader said, adding there was the feeling in the market that Hong Kong's drop on Friday was "overdone".
In Hong Kong the Hang Seng Index fell 140.39 points to 14,655.13 points, unsettled by news that Chinese banks would be banned from stock trading.
But brokers said the measures set by China were aimed to curb speculation on the domestic bourses and should have little impact impact on Hong Kong.
Hong Kong Telecom was up HK$1.8 to HK$18.9. The stock posted a new all-time-high in Hong Kong amid rumours that China may boost its stake in the company.
